beats.text: Qatar saves 59.5% of its national income. A giant economy breaks the expected pattern.
Consider the USA, the UK, and China.
The USA saves 16.8%, while the UK saves 17.3%.
China is the odd one out, saving 43%.
At the opposite end, East Timor is down 18.5%.
Gross savings count national income left after total consumption.
How much national income does your country save?
